The '''1968–69 Football League Cup''' was the ninth season of the [[Football League Cup]], a knockout competition for England's top 92 football clubs. The competition ended with the final on 15 March 1969.

[[1969 Football League Cup final|The final]] was contested by [[1968–69 Football League Third Division|Third Division]] team [[Swindon Town F.C.|Swindon Town]] and [[1968–69 Football League First Division|First Division]] side [[Arsenal F.C.|Arsenal]] at [[Wembley Stadium (1923)|Wembley Stadium]] in London. [[Roger Smart]] gave Swindon a surprise lead in the first half but [[Bobby Gould]] equalised for Arsenal in the 85th minute. In extra-time, [[Don Rogers (footballer)|Don Rogers]] scored twice for Swindon, leading them to a 3–1 victory.

==Calendar==
Of the 91 teams, 37 received a [[Bye (sports)|bye]] to the second round (teams ranked 1st–38th in the [[1967–68 Football League]], excluding [[Manchester United]] who did not compete) and the other 54 played in the first round. Semi-finals were [[Two-legged tie|two-legged]].
